SELECT 
  'Targeted' AS group_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS unique_members,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_spend,
  SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS avg_spend_per_member
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
  AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL
  AND m.member_id NOT IN (
    SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
  )

calls.statement:
WITH campaign_data AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, mailing_list_size, holdout_size, start_date, end_date
  FROM dim_campaign
  WHERE campaign_name = 'Black Week 2025'
),
targeted_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_spend,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15) THEN m.member_id END) / 
    CAST((SELECT mailing_list_size - holdout_size FROM campaign_data) AS DECIMAL) * (SELECT mailing_list_size - holdout_size FROM campaign_data) AS targeted_members
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM campaign_data) AND (SELECT end_date FROM campaign_data)
    AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL
    AND m.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15)
),
holdout_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_spend,
    (SELECT holdout_size FROM campaign_data) AS holdout_members
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM campaign_data) AND (SELECT end_date FROM campaign_data)
    AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL
    AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15)
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(190059.75 / 23826, 2) AS avg_spend_targeted,
  ROUND(11147.48 / 2747, 2) AS avg_spend_held_out,
  ROUND(190059.75 / 23826 - 11147.48 / 2747, 2) AS uplift_per_member;
